description: `--commits SHA` (repeatable, oldest first) only applies with exactly one `--reviewing` id; any other count prints a warning and the flag is ignored for the rest of the run (`commands::dispatch::commits_warning`). Two `--commits` with zero `--reviewing` warns; one `--commits` paired with one valid `--reviewing` id (resolved against a routing-log dispatch record, excluding that task's author vendor) is silent and still a clean `--dry-run`: no pane, no agent, no files, no log entry.
